diagnostics.message: The 'treemap' chart is a PowerPoint extension (chartex) chart that this exporter does not write; its data is exported as a native clustered column chart instead.

The histogram's single data column 'Sample' (6 values) was binned into 4 equal-width bins and exported as a column chart of the counts; PowerPoint's own histogram chart is not exported, and the binned counts do not restore the raw values on re-import.
The 'histogram' chart is a PowerPoint extension (chartex) chart that this exporter does not write; its data is exported as a native clustered column chart instead.
The 'pareto' chart is a PowerPoint extension (chartex) chart that this exporter does not write; its data is exported as a native clustered column chart instead.

The 'pareto' chart is a PowerPoint extension (chartex) chart that cannot represent multiple value series natively; all authored series are preserved in the fallback; its data is exported as a native clustered column chart instead.

The 'waterfall' chart is a PowerPoint extension (chartex) chart that this exporter does not write; its data is exported as a native clustered column chart instead.
The chart's single data column 'Sample' has no category column, so its 6 values are plotted against their row numbers.

The 'world' chart is a PowerPoint extension (chartex) chart that this exporter does not write; its data is exported as a native clustered column chart instead.

The 'world' chart is a PowerPoint extension (chartex) chart that PowerPoint has not yet accepted natively from this exporter (pass chartex: 'native' to write its chartex part); its data is exported as a native clustered column chart instead.

The 'world' chart is exported as a native PowerPoint map (chartex regionMap) without cached geography (no cx:geoCache; provider data is never fabricated): PowerPoint must fetch the region shapes from its online map service when the deck is opened, and until it does it shows "There was a problem getting the information for your map chart" and draws nothing. The clustered column fallback shows the same values in readers without chartex support.
